executives.name: Joaquin Duato
executives.fact: Joaquin Duato is Chairman and CEO of Johnson & Johnson (CEO since January 2022, Chairman since January 2023), leading a company of ~138,000 employees that is on track to surpass $100bn in annual revenue for the first time in 2026.
executives.ai_hypothesis: With the talc litigation largely resolved ($5.5bn settlement, 99.75% of cases) and a record revenue year, leadership bandwidth and capital are freed to redeploy toward pipeline commercialization and MedTech expansion.
executives.indegene_angle: A de-risked balance sheet and refocused leadership favor discretionary commercialization spend — a favorable environment for a portfolio-level, multi-year Company engagement across Innovative Medicine and MedTech.
executives.why_it_matters: Post-settlement and on track to surpass $100bn, the reinvestment window is open now — the highest-visibility moment for a portfolio-level pitch in years.
executives.engagement_recommendation: Bring a portfolio-level commercialization-capacity narrative aligned to the $100bn scale-up story; time outreach to the post-settlement reinvestment cycle.

target_functions.function: Innovative Medicine — Immunology franchise leadership (Tremfya, Icotyde)
target_functions.basis_fact: Stelara LOE drove a ~43% sales collapse; Tremfya surged +40.5% FY2025/+68.3% Q1 2026 and Icotyde was approved as the first IL-23-targeted oral peptide for psoriasis.
target_functions.indegene_angle: Stelara-to-Tremfya/Icotyde conversion is defensive spend J&J cannot postpone — DAAI prescriber analytics + accelerated MLR + omnichannel sequencing.
target_functions.why_it_matters: The Stelara loss compounds quarterly — conversion spend is mandatory now, not optional, making it the most time-sensitive entry point at J&J.
target_functions.engagement_recommendation: Pitch a Stelara conversion enablement program plus a full-funnel Icotyde launch across dermatology and gastroenterology.

target_functions.function: MedTech commercial & digital leadership (Cardiovascular, OTTAVA, Polyphonic)
target_functions.basis_fact: MedTech grew only +3.6% vs Innovative Medicine +6.8%; OTTAVA robotic system got FDA De Novo authorization; Polyphonic intelligent-OR network launched with Abu Dhabi DoH.
target_functions.indegene_angle: Lagging MedTech growth creates appetite for omnichannel/analytics modernization, surgeon adoption content and DAAI/Tech Solutions platform enablement.
target_functions.why_it_matters: At +3.6% versus Innovative Medicine's +6.8%, MedTech leadership needs a growth story — OTTAVA and Polyphonic give concrete hooks Company can attach to.
target_functions.engagement_recommendation: Approach with an omnichannel + analytics modernization proposal and an OTTAVA surgeon adoption/digital-training engagement.
